title: GFCC Ask Envelope v1
description: Single entry for 格契. Internals are replaceable; this envelope is not. dispatch binds to port interfaces in registry.v1, never to a named vendor service. Tatha is one implementation of this envelope.

accepted_verifiers.notes: 八角梯与配额。本版不把 role 改成 roles[]，也不把 ethos 收成唯一强制形状。

accepted_verifiers.role: 市场角色（candidate / recruiter / admin），不是八角梯
accepted_verifiers.notes: 过渡校验者。认终端现用 JWT。ethos 与八角梯留待后一版再换。

message.description: What the member wants. Caller does not pick a backend path.

circle_id.description: 围坐 / 共同体标识，须能在 circle 端口解析

dialog_mode.description: 双轨对话：协作 × 教练

port.description: Resolved first-class port or unknown. Not a JobFirst intent name.

status.description: partial = some sub-operations succeeded. Succeeded steps are not rolled back; failed steps may retry.

receipts.description: Per-port status when more than one port ran

compensation.example: memory wrote, consensus failed → status=partial; do not undo memory

parse_then_dispatch.parse: message + context → { port, confidence, slots, dialog_mode }
parse_then_dispatch.dispatch: port → tools registry adapter; adapter talks to store/policy via slots
parse_then_dispatch.invariant: Adding a capability = register adapter + mode list. Do not grow a JobFirst intent table as the spine.
